LESSON: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS WORKS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Appreciation in Creative Arts
Topic 3.1: Analysis of Creative Arts works

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Analysis of Creative Arts works. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Analysis of Creative Arts works
2. Practise Analysis of Creative Arts works at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Analysis of Creative Arts works

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Analysis of Creative Arts works
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Analysis of Creative Arts works. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Analysis of Creative Arts works at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Analysis of Creative Arts works at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Analysis of Creative Arts works
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Analysis of Creative Arts works. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Analysis of Creative Arts works using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Analysis of Creative Arts works in the examples.
2. Explain Analysis of Creative Arts works to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Analysis of Creative Arts works.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Analysis of Creative Arts works using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Analysis of Creative Arts works important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Analysis of Creative Arts works
2. Practise Analysis of Creative Arts works at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Analysis of Creative Arts works

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
